TextView.android:text: Last Updated: November 2026 • Plain English Guarantee

1. What We Store and Where Familiar is built as a local-first application. All rules, trust scores, check-ins, and usage totals are stored locally in an encrypted Room SQLite database on your device.
2. Zero Message or Browsing History Content Familiar NEVER collects, records, monitors, or transmits message body text, private chats, emails, browsing history, URLs, search queries, or keystrokes. Monitoring is strictly high-level category screen time totals (e.g., '2h 10m social media today').
3. Equal Transparency Whatever data the parent can view, the teen can also view on their screen at all times. There are no hidden tracking modes or silent camera/mic access.
4. Cloud Sync Layer If you explicitly enable optional cloud sync in local.properties, data is end-to-end synced using user-controlled parameters. If disabled, 100% of data remains exclusively on your physical phone.
5. No Data Selling or Ads Familiar is open source software. We do not sell data to advertisers, use third-party analytics trackers, or implement dark pattern guilt mechanics.
